name: Conviction
tagline: Venture firm purpose-built for AI-native 'Software 3.0' companies
summary: Conviction (Conviction Partners) is an AI-only venture firm founded in 2022 by Sarah Guo after her time as a Greylock general partner. Its thesis: we are extremely early in the translation of powerful AI models into powerful products, the AI-native 'Software 3.0' era, so it backs only companies built on frontier AI. Conviction writes US$1-25M checks from pre-seed to Series A and is often the first institutional investor. Fund I raised US$101M in 2022; Fund II closed at US$230M in January 2025, when former Sequoia partner Mike Vernal joined as General Partner. Its disclosed portfolio spans model labs, infrastructure and category-defining applications - Mistral, Harvey, Sierra, Cognition, HeyGen, Baseten, OpenEvidence and more - and it runs founder-facing programs including the No Priors podcast and the Embed grant program.

thesis.heading: Backing the 'Software 3.0' Transition
thesis.body: Conviction is purpose-built to serve AI-native, 'Software 3.0' companies, believing we are extremely early in the translation of powerful AI models into powerful products that transform industries. It invests only where the product itself is built on frontier AI rather than in AI bolted onto traditional software.

thesis.heading: Early, Concentrated, First-money-in
thesis.body: Conviction partners with what it calls the most important companies of tomorrow with US$1-25M checks, likes to invest early and is often the first investor a founder takes. It deliberately keeps a small, concentrated portfolio so it can be hands-on and serve founders deeply rather than spread thinly.

thesis.heading: Deep Networks Put to Work for Founders
thesis.body: The firm says it has a wide and deep network it puts to work for portfolio companies, understands the domain, and gravitates toward technical teams that build with velocity and pragmatism. Programs such as Embed grants, the Commit fellowship, Mixture of Experts recruiting events, a portfolio jobs board, and the No Priors and Good Company podcasts feed that ecosystem.

portfolioGroups.heading: AI Portfolio
portfolioGroups.blurb: Companies listed on conviction.com's Portfolio section (homepage, Sep 2026). The firm says it backs engineers, researchers, product folks, domain experts and dropouts, gravitating toward technical teams that build with velocity and pragmatism - plus others still in stealth.
